headline: Underlying business improves as spin-off costs dent profit
summary_short: Aptiv reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $3.27B (+2.3% y/y) and net income attributable to Aptiv of $248M ($1.17 diluted EPS), down 36.9% y/y as a $50M discontinued-operations loss from the EDS spin-off offset stronger continuing-operations profit of $298M, up from $265M a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue rose 2.3% y/y to $3.27B on 10% North America and 6% Asia Pacific growth, partly offset by EMEA and South America declines. Continuing-operations net income rose to $298M ($1.40 diluted EPS) from $265M as Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded to 18.7% from 17.1% on higher volumes and favorable FX, partly offset by commodity costs. Total net income attributable to Aptiv fell 36.9% y/y to $248M ($1.17 diluted EPS) as a $50M discontinued-operations loss tied to the completed EDS spin-off offset that improvement. Cash fell to $761M from $1.45B after the EDS spin-off's ~$1.9B dividend funded a $1.85B April senior-note redemption. Aptiv guided Q3 to $3.12B-$3.22B net sales.
confidence_notes: Regenerated summary (force-regenerate mode) — this file supersedes any prior version for this ticker/period. Aptiv completed the spin-off of its Electrical Distribution Systems (EDS) segment on April 1, 2026; EDS is now classified as discontinued operations for all periods. The shard's FY2026 Q1 figures predate that reclassification and still include EDS as continuing operations, so q/q deltas on revenue, cost of revenue, operating income, pretax income, net income, cash, debt, and equity compare a pre-spin base to a post-spin quarter and are not like-for-like — shown for completeness, not to be read as organic change. Y/y deltas (vs FY2025 Q2) are comparable: the release itself restates the prior-year quarter on a continuing-operations basis and its figures tie to our SEC-verbatim shard values. The shard's net_income_usd_m/eps_usd/eps_diluted_usd KPIs are Aptiv's total GAAP figures (continuing + discontinued operations, $248M / $1.17), which differ from the release's headline continuing-operations-only figures ($298M / $1.40) — both are correct GAAP numbers on different scopes. The shard's ebitda_usd_m ($562M) and ebit_usd_m ($428M) are Yahoo-sourced (wire) and do not reconcile with the release's own GAAP EBITDA ($606M) or Adjusted EBITDA ($613M) for the quarter — flagged, not corrected, per ledger discipline.

drivers.explanation: Growth of 10% in North America and 6% in Asia Pacific (incl. 5% China) was partially offset by declines of 8% in EMEA and 4% in South America.
GAAP operating income rose to $367M from $325M as revenue growth (+2.3%) outpaced a smaller rise in total operating expenses (+1.1%).
Total net income fell as the EDS spin-off produced a $50M discontinued-operations loss versus a $128M gain a year earlier, offsetting improved continuing-operations profit.

CEO Kevin Clark cited reaccelerating revenue growth and margin expansion for New Aptiv, double-digit Non-Automotive growth, and Robotics/Drone commercial wins, while flagging a dynamic Automotive macro backdrop and customer-mix headwind.
